preconditions: Performance Optimization must be merged first

tasks.title: Add fecIds column to legislators table
tasks.description: Add a text array column `fecIds` to the legislators table in the Drizzle schema. This stores FEC candidate IDs from congress-legislators data (legislators may have multiple FEC IDs across campaigns).
acceptance_criteria: fecIds column added as text[] to legislators table in schema.ts
Column is nullable (not all legislators have FEC IDs)
Migration generated with pnpm db:generate

tasks.title: Update legislator import script to store FEC IDs
tasks.description: Modify import-legislators.ts to extract FEC IDs from the congress-legislators YAML data (raw.id.fec field) and store them in the new fecIds column.
acceptance_criteria: Import script reads raw.id.fec from congress-legislators data
FEC IDs stored as text array in fecIds column
Legislators without FEC IDs get null (not empty array)
Existing import-legislators tests updated to cover FEC IDs

tasks.title: Run migration and backfill FEC IDs
tasks.description: Apply the schema migration to the dev branch, then run the updated import-legislators script to backfill FEC IDs for all existing legislators.
acceptance_criteria: Migration applied successfully to dev branch
FEC IDs populated for legislators that have them in congress-legislators data
Verified at least a sample of legislators have correct FEC IDs

tasks.title: Create campaignFinance table in schema
tasks.description: Add the campaignFinance table to src/db/schema.ts with columns: id (uuid), bioguideId (FK to legislators), fecId, cycle, totalReceipts, totalDisbursements, cashOnHand, totalFromPACs, totalFromIndividuals, debtsOwed, sourceUrl, lastUpdated, createdAt. Add relations in src/db/relations.ts for the FK to legislators.
acceptance_criteria: campaignFinance table defined in src/db/schema.ts
All columns from the data schema are present with correct types
bioguideId FK references legislators table
Relations defined in src/db/relations.ts for both directions
Migration generated with pnpm db:generate

tasks.title: Apply campaignFinance table migration
tasks.description: Run pnpm db:migrate (or db:push for dev) to create the campaignFinance table on the dev branch.
acceptance_criteria: campaignFinance table exists on the dev branch
FK constraint to legislators table is in place
Table can be queried via Drizzle Studio

tasks.title: Request ProPublica Campaign Finance API key
tasks.description: Email apihelp@propublica.org to request a Campaign Finance API key. This is a manual step that may take 1-2 business days.
acceptance_criteria: API key request email sent to apihelp@propublica.org
API key received and verified working against the endpoint

tasks.title: Add ProPublica API key to environment config
tasks.description: Add PROPUBLICA_CAMPAIGN_FINANCE_KEY to .dev.vars for local development and as a GitHub repository secret for CI/workflows.
acceptance_criteria: PROPUBLICA_CAMPAIGN_FINANCE_KEY set in .dev.vars
Secret added to GitHub repository settings
Key is accessible in GitHub Actions workflows

tasks.title: Create ProPublica Campaign Finance API wrapper
tasks.description: Create src/lib/propublica-finance.ts with typed fetch functions for the ProPublica Campaign Finance API. Include getCandidateByFecId(cycle, fecId) that returns typed candidate finance data. Handle errors and rate limiting (100ms delay between requests).
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/propublica-finance.ts exports getCandidateByFecId(cycle, fecId)
Response types are fully defined (totalReceipts, totalDisbursements, cashOnHand, etc.)
HTTP errors return null instead of throwing
API key read from environment variable
100ms throttle between requests

tasks.title: Write unit tests for ProPublica API wrapper
tasks.description: Add unit tests for the ProPublica finance wrapper. Mock fetch to test successful responses, error handling, and response parsing.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover successful API response parsing
Tests cover HTTP error responses (404, 429, 500)
Tests verify correct URL construction with cycle and FEC ID
Tests verify API key header is set
All tests pass with pnpm test

tasks.title: Create campaign finance sync script
tasks.description: Create src/scripts/sync-campaign-finance.ts that queries all legislators with FEC IDs, fetches their campaign finance data from ProPublica for the current cycle, and upserts results to the campaignFinance table. Handle legislators with multiple FEC IDs by using the most recent one. Add 100ms throttle between API calls.
acceptance_criteria: Script queries legislators with non-null fecIds
Fetches ProPublica data for each legislator using most recent FEC ID
Upserts to campaignFinance table (unique on bioguideId + cycle)
100ms throttle between API requests
Logs progress and any errors
Handles legislators with multiple FEC IDs correctly
Skips legislators without FEC IDs gracefully

tasks.title: Write unit tests for sync script
tasks.description: Add unit tests for the campaign finance sync script. Mock database queries and API calls to test the sync logic, including handling of multiple FEC IDs, upsert behavior, and error handling.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover sync of legislator with single FEC ID
Tests cover sync of legislator with multiple FEC IDs (picks most recent)
Tests cover legislators without FEC IDs being skipped
Tests cover API error handling during sync
All tests pass with pnpm test

tasks.title: Add sync:finance npm script
tasks.description: Add "sync:finance": "tsx src/scripts/sync-campaign-finance.ts" to package.json scripts.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm sync:finance runs the sync script successfully
Script exits with code 0 on success, non-zero on failure

tasks.title: Run initial data sync on dev branch
tasks.description: Run the sync script against the dev database to populate campaign finance data. Verify data looks correct by spot-checking a few legislators in Drizzle Studio.
acceptance_criteria: Campaign finance data populated for legislators with FEC IDs
At least 400+ legislators have finance records (of 535 total)
Spot-check: data matches ProPublica for 3-5 known legislators
No errors in sync script output

tasks.title: Add campaign finance sync to refresh-data workflow
tasks.description: Add pnpm sync:finance as a step in the .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml GitHub Action so campaign finance data syncs daily alongside other data refreshes.
acceptance_criteria: sync:finance step added to refresh-data.yml workflow
PROPUBLICA_CAMPAIGN_FINANCE_KEY secret passed to the step
Step runs after legislator import (since it depends on FEC IDs)

tasks.title: Create campaign finance database query module
tasks.description: Create src/db/queries/campaign-finance.ts with getFinanceByMember(db, bioguideId) using the Drizzle relational API. Should return the most recent cycle's data for a given legislator. Export the return type.
acceptance_criteria: getFinanceByMember(db, bioguideId) exported from module
Uses db.query.campaignFinance relational API (not manual joins)
Returns most recent cycle data or null if none exists
Return type exported as CampaignFinanceData type alias

tasks.title: Write unit tests for campaign finance query module
tasks.description: Add unit tests for the campaign finance query function. Mock the database to test query construction, handling of missing data, and correct cycle ordering.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover legislator with finance data
Tests cover legislator without finance data (returns null)
Tests cover multiple cycles (returns most recent)
All tests pass with pnpm test

tasks.title: Create CampaignFinance React component
tasks.description: Create src/components/CampaignFinance.tsx that displays campaign finance data: total raised with cycle context, total disbursements, cash on hand, PAC vs individual contribution breakdown (as percentage bar or similar visualization), and debts owed. Handle missing data gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Component displays total receipts prominently with cycle year
Total disbursements shown
Cash on hand shown
PAC vs individual contribution breakdown visualized
Debts owed shown when present
Handles null/missing data with 'Not available' message
Follows existing component patterns in the codebase

tasks.title: Write unit tests for CampaignFinance component
tasks.description: Add unit tests for the CampaignFinance component. Test rendering with full data, partial data, null data, and verify correct formatting of currency values.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover rendering with complete finance data
Tests cover rendering with null/missing data
Tests verify currency formatting
Tests verify PAC vs individual breakdown percentages
All tests pass with pnpm test

tasks.title: Add CampaignFinance section to rep profile page
tasks.description: Integrate the CampaignFinance component into src/pages/rep/[bioguideId].astro. Fetch finance data in the page's frontmatter using getFinanceByMember and pass it as props. Add a 'Data from ProPublica/FEC' attribution link below the component.
acceptance_criteria: CampaignFinance component renders on rep profile page
Finance data fetched server-side in Astro frontmatter
Attribution link to ProPublica/FEC.gov displayed below the section
FEC source URL links to the specific candidate's FEC page
Section hidden gracefully when no finance data exists

tasks.title: Add integration test for campaign finance query
tasks.description: Add an integration test that runs against the real dev database to verify the campaign finance query returns correct data structure and handles edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Integration test queries a known legislator with finance data
Integration test verifies data shape matches expected types
Integration test handles legislator without finance data
Test file named campaign-finance.integration.test.ts
Test passes with pnpm test:integration

tasks.title: Add E2E test for campaign finance on rep page
tasks.description: Create tests/e2e/campaign-finance.spec.ts that navigates to a rep profile page and verifies the campaign finance section renders with expected data elements (total raised, breakdown, attribution link).
acceptance_criteria: E2E test navigates to a rep profile page
Verifies campaign finance section is visible
Verifies total raised amount is displayed
Verifies PAC/individual breakdown is present
Verifies attribution link is present and correct
Test passes with pnpm test:e2e

tasks.title: Final verification and cleanup
tasks.description: Run full lint, typecheck, and test suite. Verify all acceptance criteria from the verification checklist in docs/tasks/campaign-finance.md. Ensure no regressions in existing tests.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint passes
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm test passes (all unit tests)
pnpm test:integration passes
pnpm test:e2e passes
All items in docs/tasks/campaign-finance.md verification checklist pass
